dedupe_keys.name: enriched data of wind farms edwin

description: Enriched Data of Wind Farms, or EDWin, combines OpenStreetMap wind turbine mapping with variables from other sources to give two linked tables: 359,947 turbines and 20,608 wind farms worldwide. Marina Haller compiled it to describe how farms sit in the landscape. Variables include coordinates, country, continent, land cover, landform, elevation, turbine spacing and wind farm shape. Coverage is global at asset level and the data are current as of September 2022. The single EDWin.xlsx file of 12.4 MB is free to download from Zenodo under CC-BY-4.0, and the deposit was published on 22 January 2023. Caveats: it is a one-off snapshot with no update plan, it inherits the completeness of OpenStreetMap mapping, which varies by country, and it carries no capacity or commissioning attributes. It suits exposure and siting analysis of wind assets, spacing and land use studies, and as a location layer for energy system models. Related catalogue records: data-harmonised-global-wind-solar-farm-locations-osm, data-gem-global-wind-power-tracker and data-us-wind-turbine-database-uswtdb.
